⛔️TRAFFIC ADVISORY - FENWAY PARK:
Hozier Concerts – Mon & Tue, June 23-24
For public safety and logistical needs of the concerts several temporary parking restrictions will need to be implemented.
Parking restrictions will be in place throughout Monday and Tuesday on the following streets:
Brookline Ave - Both sides from Overland to Lansdowne
Overland St - South side (even side), from Brookline Ave to Beacon
Boylston St - South side from opposite Ipswich, near Fenway Park, to Brookline Ave
Lansdowne St - Both sides, from Brookline Ave to Ipswich
Ipswich St - North side (Fenway Park side), from Lansdowne to Boylston
Van Ness St - Both sides, from Ipswich to Kilmarnock
Richard B Ross Way - Both sides, from Van Ness to Boylston
